name: Golden Days?
source:
After several years, you return to your old town, a small rural town in the countryside. You had big dreams in the big city, but... it just... didn't work out. Returning to your old town is like an admission of your failure. You'll reunite with your childhood friends; everything seems different. Are there still remnants of your golden days? Or perhaps the golden days aren't so bright after all...

[From [url=https://dekawolf.itch.io/golden-days-furry-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
